game.title: Pong Game
game.increaseWindow: Please increase your window size to play the game properly.
game.bestExperience: For the best experience, use a larger screen or maximize your browser window.

howToPlay.hitBall: Hit the ball with your paddle to return it to your opponent.
howToPlay.scorePoints: Score points when your opponent misses the ball.
howToPlay.firstToWin: First player to reach the win score wins the game!
howToPlay.multiplayerDesc: Multiplayer (4P) Mode: In this tag-team mode, when a paddle hits the ball, it becomes inactive until its teammate hits the ball. Teams score points together.
howToPlay.tournamentDesc: Tournament Mode: 4 players compete in semifinals and then a final match to determine the champion.
howToPlay.ballSpeed: The ball speeds up after each hit.
howToPlay.paddleEdge: Hitting the ball with the edge of the paddle gives it a steeper angle.
howToPlay.adjustSettings: You can adjust game settings before starting a match.
